hints.title: Subarray Starting Criteria
hints.text: The leftmost element of the subarray must be even and cannot exceed the given threshold.

hints.title: Alternating Extension
hints.text: Extend rightward as long as neighboring elements alternate parities and stay within threshold bounds.

hints.title: Max Length Record
hints.text: Track the maximum valid subarray length across all qualified starting positions.

hints.title: Subarray Traversal Code

complexity.notes: Each subarray expansion checks contiguous valid alternating elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all subarray slices takes O(n^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Verifies starting conditions and alternating parity constraints properly.
